verses.en: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
verses.pt: Naquele dia levantou-se grande perseguição contra a igreja que estava em Jerusalém; e todos exceto os apóstolos, foram dispersos pelas regiões da Judéia e da Samária.
verses.en_web: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.
verses.en_bbe: And Saul gave approval to his death. Now at that time a violent attack was started against the church in Jerusalem; and all but the Apostles went away into all parts of Judaea and Samaria.

verses.en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
verses.pt: E uns homens piedosos sepultaram a Estêvão, e fizeram grande pranto sobre ele.
verses.en_web: Devout men buried Stephen, and lamented greatly over him.
verses.en_bbe: And God-fearing men put Stephen's body in its last resting-place, making great weeping over him.

verses.en: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
verses.pt: Saulo porém, assolava a igreja, entrando pelas casas e, arrastando homens e mulheres, os entregava à prisão.
verses.en_web: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house, and dragged both men and women off to prison.
verses.en_bbe: But Saul was burning with hate against the church, going into every house and taking men and women and putting them in prison.

verses.en: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
verses.pt: No entanto os que foram dispersos iam por toda parte, anunciando a palavra.
verses.en_web: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
verses.en_bbe: But those who had gone in flight went everywhere preaching the word.

verses.en: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
verses.pt: E descendo Filipe à cidade de Samária, pregava-lhes a Cristo.
verses.en_web: Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and proclaimed to them the Christ.
verses.en_bbe: And Philip went down to Samaria and was teaching them about Christ.

verses.en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
verses.pt: As multidões escutavam, unânimes, as coisas que Filipe dizia, ouvindo-o e vendo os sinais que operava;
verses.en_web: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
verses.en_bbe: And all the people gave attention to the words which Philip said, when they saw the signs which he did.

verses.en: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
verses.pt: pois saíam de muitos possessos os espíritos imundos, clamando em alta voz; e muitos paralíticos e coxos foram curados;
verses.en_web: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
verses.en_bbe: For unclean spirits came out from those who had them, crying with a loud voice; and a number of those who were ill and broken in body were made well.

verses.en: And there was great joy in that city.
verses.pt: pelo que houve grande alegria naquela cidade.
verses.en_web: There was great joy in that city.
verses.en_bbe: And there was much joy in that town.

verses.en: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
verses.pt: Ora, estava ali certo homem chamado Simão, que vinha exercendo naquela cidade a arte mágica, fazendo pasmar o povo da Samária, e dizendo ser ele uma grande personagem;
verses.en_web: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city, and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
verses.en_bbe: But there was a certain man named Simon, who in the past had been a wonder-worker and a cause of surprise to the people of Samaria, saying that he himself was a great man:

verses.en: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
verses.pt: ao qual todos atendiam, desde o menor até o maior, dizendo: Este é o Poder de Deus que se chama Grande.
verses.en_web: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”
verses.en_bbe: To whom they all gave attention, from the smallest to the greatest, saying, This man is that power of God which is named Great.

verses.en: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
verses.pt: Eles o atendiam porque já desde muito tempo os vinha fazendo pasmar com suas artes mágicas.
verses.en_web: They listened to him, because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave attention to him, because for a long time his wonder-working powers had kept them under his control.

verses.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.pt: Mas, quando creram em Filipe, que lhes pregava acerca do reino de Deus e do nome de Jesus, batizavam-se homens e mulheres.
verses.en_web: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
verses.en_bbe: But when they had faith in the good news given by Philip about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, a number of men and women had baptism.

verses.en: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
verses.pt: E creu até o próprio Simão e, sendo batizado, ficou de contínuo com Filipe; e admirava-se, vendo os sinais e os grandes milagres que se faziam.
verses.en_web: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
verses.en_bbe: And Simon himself had faith and, having had baptism, he went with Philip and, seeing the signs and the great wonders which he did, he was full of surprise.

verses.en: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
verses.pt: Os apóstolos, pois, que estavam em Jerusalém, tendo ouvido que os da Samária haviam recebido a palavra de Deus, enviaram-lhes Pedro e João;
verses.en_web: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,
verses.en_bbe: Now when the Apostles at Jerusalem had news that the people of Samaria had taken the word of God into their hearts, they sent to them Peter and John;

verses.en: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
verses.pt: os quais, tendo descido, oraram por eles, para que recebessem o Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;
verses.en_bbe: Who, when they came there, made prayer for them, that the Holy Spirit might be given to them:

verses.en: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
verses.pt: Porque sobre nenhum deles havia ele descido ainda; mas somente tinham sido batizados em nome do Senhor Jesus.
verses.en_web: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: For up to that time he had not come on any of them; only baptism had been given to them in the name of the Lord Jesus.

verses.en: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: Então lhes impuseram as mãos, e eles receberam o Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Then they put their hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came on them.

verses.en: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles’ hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
verses.pt: Quando Simão viu que pela imposição das mãos dos apóstolos se dava o Espírito Santo, ofereceu-lhes dinheiro,
verses.en_web: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,
verses.en_bbe: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the touch of the Apostles' hands, he made them an offering of money, saying,

verses.en: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: dizendo: Dai-me também a mim esse poder, para que aquele sobre quem eu impuser as mãos, receba o Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”
verses.en_bbe: Give me this power, so that when I put my hands on anyone he may get the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
verses.pt: Mas disse-lhe Pedro: Vá tua prata contigo à perdição, pois cuidaste adquirir com dinheiro o dom de Deus.
verses.en_web: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!
verses.en_bbe: But Peter said, May your money come to destruction with you, because you had the idea that what is freely given by God may be got for a price.

verses.en: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
verses.pt: Tu não tens parte nem sorte neste ministério, porque o teu coração não é reto diante de Deus.
verses.en_web: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.
verses.en_bbe: You have no part in this business, because your heart is not right before God.

verses.en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
verses.pt: Arrepende-te, pois, dessa tua maldade, e roga ao Senhor para que porventura te seja perdoado o pensamento do teu coração;
verses.en_web: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
verses.en_bbe: Let your heart be changed, and make prayer to God that you may have forgiveness for your evil thoughts.

verses.en: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
verses.pt: pois vejo que estás em fel de amargura, e em laços de iniquidade.
verses.en_web: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”
verses.en_bbe: For I see that you are prisoned in bitter envy and the chains of sin.

verses.en: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
verses.pt: Respondendo, porém, Simão, disse: Rogai vós por mim ao Senhor, para que nada do que haveis dito venha sobre mim.
verses.en_web: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”
verses.en_bbe: And Simon, answering, said, Make prayer for me to the Lord, so that these things which you have said may not come on me.

verses.en: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.pt: Eles, pois, havendo testificado e falado a palavra do Senhor, voltando para Jerusalém, evangelizavam muitas aldeias dos samaritanos.
verses.en_web: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
verses.en_bbe: So they, having given their witness and made clear the word of the Lord, went back to Jerusalem, giving the good news on their way in a number of the small towns of Samaria.

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
verses.pt: Mas um anjo do Senhor falou a Filipe, dizendo: Levanta-te, e vai em direção do sul pelo caminho que desce de Jerusalém a Gaza, o qual está deserto.
verses.en_web: But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”
verses.en_bbe: But an angel of the Lord said to Philip, Get up, and go to the south, to the road which goes from Jerusalem to Gaza, through the waste land.

verses.en: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
verses.pt: E levantou-se e foi; e eis que um etíope, eunuco, mordomo- mor de Candace, rainha dos etíopes, o qual era superintendente de todos os seus tesouros e tinha ido a Jerusalém para adorar,
verses.en_web: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.
verses.en_bbe: And he went and there was a man of Ethiopia, a servant of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, and controller of all her property, who had come up to Jerusalem for worship;

verses.en: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
verses.pt: regressava e, sentado no seu carro, lia o profeta Isaías.
verses.en_web: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.
verses.en_bbe: He was going back, seated in his carriage, and was reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.

verses.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
verses.pt: Disse o Espírito a Filipe: Chega-te e ajunta-te a esse carro.
verses.en_web: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Spirit said to Philip, Go near, and get on his carriage.

verses.en: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
verses.pt: E correndo Filipe, ouviu que lia o profeta Isaías, e disse: Entendes, porventura, o que estás lendo?
verses.en_web: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
verses.en_bbe: And Philip, running up to him, saw that he was reading Isaiah the prophet, and said to him, Is the sense of what you are reading clear to you?

verses.en: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
verses.pt: Ele respondeu: Pois como poderei entender, se alguém não me ensinar? e rogou a Filipe que subisse e com ele se sentasse.
verses.en_web: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.
verses.en_bbe: And he said, How is that possible when I have no guide? And he made Philip get up by his side.

verses.en: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
verses.pt: Ora, a passagem da Escritura que estava lendo era esta: Foi levado como a ovelha ao matadouro, e, como está mudo o cordeiro diante do que o tosquia, assim ele não abre a sua boca.
verses.en_web: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.
verses.en_bbe: Now the place in the book where he was reading was this: He was taken, like a sheep, to be put to death; and as a lamb is quiet when its wool is being cut, so he made no sound:

verses.en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
verses.pt: Na sua humilhação foi tirado o seu julgamento; quem contará a sua geração? porque a sua vida é tirada da terra.
verses.en_web: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: Being of low degree, his cause was not given a hearing: who has knowledge of his family? for his life is cut off from the earth.

verses.en: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
verses.pt: Respondendo o eunuco a Filipe, disse: Rogo-te, de quem diz isto o profeta? de si mesmo, ou de algum outro?
verses.en_web: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”
verses.en_bbe: And the Ethiopian said to Philip, About whom are these words said by the prophet? about himself, or some other?

verses.en: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
verses.pt: Então Filipe tomou a palavra e, começando por esta escritura, anunciou-lhe a Jesus.
verses.en_web: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: So Philip, starting from this writing, gave him the good news about Jesus.

verses.en: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
verses.pt: E indo eles caminhando, chegaram a um lugar onde havia água, e disse o eunuco: Eis aqui água; que impede que eu seja batizado?
verses.en_web: As they went on the way, they came to some water, and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”
verses.en_bbe: And while they were going on their way, they came to some water, and the Ethiopian said, See, here is water; why may I not have baptism?

verses.en: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
verses.pt: [E disse Felipe: é lícito, se crês de todo o coração. E, respondendo ele, disse: Creio que Jesus Cristo é o Filho de Deus.]
verses.en_web: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.

verses.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
verses.pt: mandou parar o carro, e desceram ambos à água, tanto Filipe como o eunuco, e Filipe o batizou.
verses.en_web: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave orders for the carriage to be stopped, and the two of them went down into the water, and Philip gave him baptism.

verses.en: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.pt: Quando saíram da água, o Espírito do Senhor arrebatou a Filipe, e não o viu mais o eunuco, que jubiloso seguia o seu caminho.
verses.en_web: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord took Philip away; and the Ethiopian saw him no more, for he went on his way full of joy.

verses.en: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
verses.pt: Mas Filipe achou-se em Azoto e, indo passando, evangelizava todas as cidades, até que chegou a Cesaréia.
verses.en_web: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.
verses.en_bbe: But Philip came to Azotus, and went through all the towns, preaching the good news, till he came to Caesarea.
